name: BizBuzz Lead Qualification (Gemini + HubSpot + Supabase + Langfuse)

parameters.content:
## BizBuzz lead qualification
Webhook -> validate -> Gemini classifies -> HubSpot contact and note -> Supabase SQL row -> Langfuse trace.

Setup: see README. Fill the 5 credentials, run supabase_schema.sql, then send test_leads.json with send_tests.sh.
Spam goes to SQL only, never to the CRM.
